Alexander " Sascha " Van der Bellen ( German: [alɛkˈsandɐ fan deːɐ̯ ˈbɛlən] ; born 18 January 1944), also referred to by the abbreviation VdB , is an Austrian politician serving as the president of Austria since 2017. He previously was a professor of economics at the University of Vienna , and after joining politics, the spokesman of the Austrian Green Party . [ 1 ] [ 2 ]
